summary: P0 DR restore-safety release. Restore stage 40 validates REPORTS_ROOT and WEATHER_DATA_DIR (python-decouple semantics) before any mutation via a shared content-root safety primitive, refusing system, anchor, checkout and managed-root paths, staged aliases and symlink escapes; roots are created via no-follow descriptors; report ownership is member-scoped, never recursive. Docs: recovery-payload refresh obligation; publication invariant. No runtime, migration, package, systemd or static changes.
